mathematics.assertion_tested: Symbolic normalized third Chern identity and line-tensor invariance; absence of anti-K elements in a quadratic field; five-dimensional ambient-block invariance in a stated seven-dimensional formal representation.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Rational functions in r,c1,c2,c3; rational polynomial matrices; formal t-series through degree three.
mathematics.conventions: Chern index is algebraic codimension. Matrix actions are on columns. Ambient coordinates precede two formal Weil coordinates.

exclusions: d=0 in the quadratic centralizer conclusion
bounds.geometric_regime: r positive integer and d positive rational; seven-dimensional matrices are a formal model only

non_claims: No construction of an auxiliary sheaf or algebraic source.
No Betti or Hodge realization of the formal matrices.
No exhaustion of all GST operations or all algebraic correspondences.
No refutation or proof of the Hodge conjecture.
No formalization of the external T6 theorem or canonical cycle-class map.

checks: Both symbolic Chern residuals are zero.
The quadratic centralizer commutator is zero; generic anti-K solution is aa=bb=0 for d nonzero.
Every stated generator has a zero lower-left block.
Five successive nonzero Lefschetz seed vectors have exact rank five and zero Weil coordinates.
All-word invariance follows by the separate block-multiplication argument recorded in the manuscript; no word-length sampling is used as a universal proof.
result: Stated symbolic identities verified; they do not provide the missing geometric source or unconditional theorem.
residual_risks: Version 1 metadata does not instrument the remote host; runtime includes API overhead.
Geometric interpretation requires the explicitly stated dictionaries.
An initial implementation used MatrixPower on a singular matrix at exponent zero; the successful run uses the direct vector recurrence NestList.
